conditions.network: loopback (bots and server on the same machine)
conditions.server: spawned child process, in-memory rooms + file snapshots
conditions.clients: headless bot swarm (socket.io-client) running the browser SyncCore against a simulated player (+-0.4% clock skew, 40-120ms seek latency)

scenarios.name: Baseline LAN
scenarios.description: 10 users, mixed play/pause/seek every 3-8s from 3 concurrent actors, chat + reactions

scenarios.name: Degraded network
scenarios.description: 10 users; 3 of them on +100ms RTT with 2% TCP retransmissions (RTO 200ms)

checks.label: Degraded clients still applied on the shared timeline
checks.detail: degraded p95 66.8ms (includes the emulated 50ms one-way + retransmits)

scenarios.name: Join storm
scenarios.description: 5 users watching; 10 more join within 2s mid-playback. Measures time-to-sync per late joiner

checks.label: Late join lands in sync < 3s
checks.detail: time-to-sync p50 1887ms, max 1918ms (incl. REST join + 10-ping clock burst)

scenarios.name: Reconnect storm
scenarios.description: 10 users; 5 lose the network for 5s and come back (lastEseq replay / snapshot)

checks.label: Resynced within 5s of the network returning
checks.detail: p50 460ms, max 460ms (includes socket backoff + clock burst)

scenarios.name: Host drop
scenarios.description: 10 users; the host disappears. Auto succession after the 10s grace, playback uninterrupted

scenarios.name: Server crash + restart
scenarios.description: 10 users; the server is SIGKILLed mid-playback and restarted. Rooms restore from snapshots, clients reconnect

checks.label: All clients back in sync after restart

scenarios.name: Buffering laggard
scenarios.description: 10 users; one client stalls for 3s. Room policy WAIT_FOR_ALL freezes everyone, then resumes together

checks.label: Room waited for the buffering client

scenarios.name: Soak
scenarios.description: 25 users, continuous playback with occasional actions; drift must stay <= 500ms the whole time
